rules.title: Lead rules and inbox
rules.subtitle: How leads get handed out and where they come in on their own.

strategy.MANUAL_help: Leads arrive with no agent and someone hands them out.
strategy.ROTACION_help: It goes to whoever has waited longest for one.
strategy.ZONA_help: To the agent who works that neighborhood or city.
strategy.TURNO_help: To whoever is on duty at that hour.

rules.reassignHelp: If the agent does not log contact in time, the lead moves on to the next one by itself and it is written in the log. This is what keeps a lead from sitting untouched all weekend.
rules.reassignMinutes: Minutes with no contact before moving it on
rules.reassignMinutesHelp: 15 minutes by default: after 10, the odds of reaching them have already dropped 80%.
rules.reassignHops: How many times it can bounce
rules.reassignHopsHelp: Once it hits the cap it stays with the last agent and stops bouncing.
rules.poolHelp: With nobody ticked, everyone who can work leads is in.
rules.zonesHelp: Only used with the by-area rule. Type the area and pick who takes it.
rules.shiftsHelp: Only used with the by-shift rule. Times in {tz}.
rules.toleranceHelp: Nobody types their real budget. With ±10%, someone who said "up to 2 million" still sees the 2.15 house.
rules.readonly: Only someone who hands out leads can change this.

inbox.title: Your inbox for the portals
inbox.help: Set this address as the contact email in your portal account, or forward to it. Every notice that arrives becomes a lead on its own, with an agent already assigned.
inbox.notConfigured: The mail connection is not set up on the server yet. Tell support before you put it in the portals.
inbox.howTitle: How to set it in each portal
inbox.howGeneric: Go to your portal account settings, find the email where you receive contacts and replace it with this address. If the portal will not let you change it, set up a forwarding rule in your mailbox.
inbox.logEmpty: No email has reached this inbox yet.
inbox.logHelp: The original email is stored: if a portal changes its template and stops parsing, this is what fixes it without guessing.

lostReasons.PRECIO: The price did not work for them

empty.title: No leads yet
empty.body: As soon as you connect your inbox to the portals, every notice that arrives becomes a lead on its own. In the meantime you can add one by hand.
